courses.title: JavaScript: From Zero to Hero
courses.subtitle: Build a strong foundation in modern JavaScript.
courses.description: Learn variables, functions, arrays, objects, DOM basics and asynchronous JavaScript with short, practical lessons.

lessons.title: Welcome and course roadmap
lessons.content: Welcome! In this course you will learn JavaScript step by step. Start with the basics, practise every concept, and build small projects as you go.

lessons.title: Variables and data types
lessons.content: Use const by default and let when reassignment is needed. JavaScript has primitive values such as string, number, boolean, null, undefined, bigint and symbol, plus objects.

lessons.title: Functions and arrow functions
lessons.content: Functions package reusable behaviour. Function declarations, expressions and arrow functions differ in syntax and how they handle this. Keep functions small and give them clear names.

lessons.title: Arrays and objects
lessons.content: Arrays store ordered collections. Objects represent keyed data. Practise map, filter, find, reduce, destructuring and spread syntax.

lessons.title: Async JavaScript and fetch
lessons.content: Promises represent future results. async/await makes promise-based code easier to read. fetch() can request data from HTTP APIs; check response.ok before parsing the body.

courses.title: Spring Boot & REST APIs
courses.subtitle: Create clean backend services with Spring Boot.
courses.description: Understand controllers, services, repositories, validation, exception handling and REST API design through a practical backend workflow.

lessons.title: Spring Boot project structure
lessons.content: A typical Spring Boot application separates web controllers, business services and data access. Keep configuration external and organise packages by feature or layer.

lessons.title: Dependency injection
lessons.content: Spring manages beans in its application context. Constructor injection makes dependencies explicit, improves testability and helps avoid partially initialised objects.

lessons.title: Build a REST controller
lessons.content: Use @RestController for JSON endpoints, mapping annotations for routes, DTOs for request and response shapes, and meaningful HTTP status codes.

lessons.title: Validation and exception handling
lessons.content: Validate request DTOs with Jakarta Bean Validation and @Valid. Use @RestControllerAdvice to translate exceptions into consistent, useful API error responses.

courses.title: HTML, CSS & Responsive Design
courses.subtitle: Design responsive web pages from scratch.
courses.description: Learn semantic HTML, CSS layouts, Flexbox, Grid, responsive breakpoints and accessible interface basics.

lessons.title: Semantic HTML
lessons.content: Choose elements based on meaning: header, nav, main, section, article and footer. Semantic markup improves accessibility and helps maintainers understand your page.

lessons.title: CSS layout with Flexbox
lessons.content: Flexbox is ideal for arranging items along one dimension. Practise justify-content, align-items, gap, flex-wrap and flexible sizing.

lessons.title: Responsive design with Grid
lessons.content: CSS Grid is useful for two-dimensional layouts. Combine minmax(), repeat(), auto-fit and media queries to build layouts that adapt to different screens.

courses.title: SQL Essentials for Developers
courses.subtitle: Query relational data with confidence.
courses.description: Practise SELECT, filtering, joins, aggregation, subqueries and indexes with developer-focused examples.

lessons.title: Tables and SELECT
lessons.content: Relational databases store data in tables. SELECT retrieves columns, WHERE filters rows, ORDER BY sorts results, and LIMIT caps the number of returned rows.

lessons.title: JOINs explained
lessons.content: INNER JOIN returns matching rows, LEFT JOIN preserves every row from the left table, and joining on the right keys connects related data.

lessons.title: GROUP BY and aggregates
lessons.content: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN and MAX aggregate values. GROUP BY forms groups, while HAVING filters aggregated groups.
